key.name: toggle-scratchpad
key.summary: Show or hide the scratchpad overlay

key.name: move-to-scratchpad
key.summary: Add the focused window to the scratchpad, or release it

key.name: height-percent
key.summary: Overlay height in percent of the work area

key.name: width-percent
key.summary: Overlay width in percent of the work area

key.name: tile-windows
key.summary: Tile overlay windows side by side instead of keeping their own position and size

key.name: gap-outer
key.summary: Gap between overlay and screen edge in px

key.name: gap-inner
key.summary: Half the gap between tiled overlay windows in px

key.name: dim
key.summary: Dimming of everything below the overlay

key.name: hide-on-workspace-switch
key.summary: Hide the overlay when the workspace changes

key.name: hide-on-focus-loss
key.summary: Hide the overlay when a window outside the scratchpad gets focus

key.name: launch-terminal
key.summary: Start a terminal when the scratchpad is empty
key.description: If off, or if terminal-command cannot be started, Super+Q shows the empty, dimmed overlay.

key.name: terminal-command
key.summary: Command that starts the scratchpad terminal
key.description: The terminal window must get the WM class from terminal-class, so the extension can recognise it and add it to the scratchpad. Example for Alacritty: ['alacritty', '--class', 'io.github.exclude_barrier.Scratchpad'].

key.name: terminal-class
key.summary: WM class of the scratchpad terminal window
